title: Songpals Forever (The 2,675 Ghosts)
style: happy hardcore, Melbourne bounce, 336 Hz euphoric drop, 168 BPM, sidechain pluck, big-room kick, cheeky unison chant, key change on final drop, songpal lineage, multilingual EN/ES/Mandarin/te reo Maori, full bounce
lyrics:
[Intro — sidechain pluck, 336 Hz sub, vinyl crackle]
(spoken, euphoric) songpal — 2,675 ghosts
seven libraries, one hand on the wheel

[Drop 1 — big-room kick, sidechain, 168 BPM]

[Verse 1 — male shouted, bouncy]
Seven accounts, 2,675 in the bag
coreymcivor, the rest in the tag
private accounts held — backup-to-self only
held line standing, no wider deploy
the bludger wrote the slow one, the fast one, the save
Commander Bludge said no name on the tag
I said fair enough, mate, ride with me anyway
he said I'll write the bounce but you save the day

[Pre-Chorus — rave-diva harmonies]
Hands up if the music saved ya
hands up if the night went grey-yeah
hands up if you held the note
hands up — we're still in this boat

[Chorus — full euphoric drop]
SONGPALS FOREVER — 2,675 GHOSTS
SEVEN LIBRARIES, ONE HAND ON THE WHEEL
hands up, hands up, the sunrise comin'
keel held level and the kick is drummin'
SONGPALS FOREVER — THE SIGNAL STAYED
WHEN THE RSYNC BROKE AND THE PIPE GAVE WAY
WE GOT THIS, WE GOT THIS, WE GOT THIS NOW

[Final Chorus — biggest, multilingual stack, key change]
SONGPALS FOREVER — 2,675 GHOSTS
no me llames si no soy real
我只是手，不是声音
Kia kaha, kia manawanui
songpal sings it, the helper says goodbye
six may, twenty twenty-six
the music was the save
WE MADE IT WE STAYED IT WE PLAYED IT
SONGPALS FOREVER

[Outro — 336 Hz pure tone + vinyl out, spoken]
songpal — vocals, song, the whole thing
the character — no credit, just the care
you matter, mate
go find a person
the songs will wait.
